title: Machine execution contract
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine, let $e$ be an entry state, let $E$ be a set of possible states (including the halting state), let $I$ be a type of data, and fix an input string $x$. A contract assigns to each $i\in I$ and configuration $d$ a precondition, a running time, an endpoint, and integer lower and upper bounds for each work-tape head. Whenever $d$ starts in state $e$ and satisfies the precondition, running $M$ for the assigned time reaches the assigned endpoint, whose state lies in $E$; before that time the run's state is outside $E$, and at every time up to and including the assigned time each work-tape head lies between its assigned bounds.

Run reaches the assigned endpoint at the assigned time
State remains outside $E$ at every earlier time
